async function craftOneStonePickaxe(bot) {
    // This function attempts to create a stone pickaxe if one is not already present in the inventory. It first verifies that the bot possesses at least three cobblestone and two sticks. It then searches for a crafting table within a 32-block radius. If a table is found, the bot navigates to it and proceeds to craft one stone pickaxe. If any required materials or the crafting table are missing, an error is thrown.
}
